pages.title: A obra e a situação

work.title: Walden
work.note: Walden é um livro do escritor americano Henry David Thoreau, publicado em 1854. A cena cultural serve de ponte para o foco “falar de uma subida: reach the top (chegar ao topo) e enjoy the view (curtir a vista)”. A referência mostra uma caminhada no bosque: reach the top, enjoy the view.

paragraphs: It is Saturday morning in a small flower shop in Savannah. Buckets of roses, tulips and sunflowers fill the shop. The air smells sweet and fresh. Dan walks in and looks around with wide eyes. A florist named Flo arranges tulips at the counter. She greets him warmly.
“Good morning! Looking for flowers?” says Flo. “Yes. Last month, I bought roses for my mother.” says Dan. “Lovely! Did she like them?” says Flo.

Com we, a forma base: make.

She ___ every day. → loves
He is ___ now. → lasting
